title: Certification transferability computed by inference, not confirmation
notes: declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until thresholds are set (design Decision 8). Non-negotiable boundary #5; the write-time repository hard block on transferability_basis='inferred' (design overturn 7) is the companion control at a different layer. Classification (ADR-0060): class (iii) — no snapshot var; proposed: cert.transferability_inferred_count (count of certification rows with transferability_basis='inferred'); the write-time repository block is the companion control and this predicate is the tripwire.
